minutes.title: Product Design Meeting
minutes.summary: The meeting discussed product themes, colors, and design elements. Decisions were made on incorporating a jog dial for volume and brightness controls, using yellow as the corporate color, and focusing on a unified concept with a snowman-shaped design. Next steps include drawing the proposed design and discussing material choices.
decisions: We will incorporate a jog dial for volume and brightness controls

actions.task: Discuss the size, shape, and button placement of the control
Incorporate suggestions from previous controls into the design
Discuss incorporating fruit and veg themes into the user interface design
Draw the proposed snowman-shaped design on the board.
Forward the decision on incorporating a jog dial to others.
Swipe power cable out and pull everyone out first, then put in whoever needs to be left.
